entries.name: Fishalike
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: The default theme: a darkened light red with pink touches.

entries.name: Abyss
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Deep sea blue with cyan. Extends Fishalike.

entries.name: Sakura Paper
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Light theme: cream paper and cherry pink.

entries.name: Ink
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Pure black for OLED screens, with soft white and a touch of pink. Extends Fishalike.

entries.name: Moss
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Deep forest green with moss and amber. Extends Fishalike.

entries.name: Daylight
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: A clean light theme: white, soft grays and coral. Extends Fishalike.

entries.name: YouTube / SoundCloud (yt-dlp)
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Search YouTube, YouTube Music or SoundCloud with the 'ytdlp' Go module (needs yt-dlp). Also plays tracks from metadata-only plugins (Deezer…) by finding them on YouTube, and recommends tracks through YouTube mixes.

entries.name: Radio Browser
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Thousands of online radios from radio-browser.info. 100% declarative: only endpoints and field mapping, no code.

entries.name: Deezer (search & charts)
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Search, charts and artist radios from the public Deezer API, with real album covers. Metadata only: tracks are played through an fnt plugin with "match" (e.g. yt-dlp). 100% declarative.

entries.name: Lavalink
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Searches a Lavalink v4 server (YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Spotify/Deezer/Apple through LavaSrc…). Lavalink resolves the tracks; the audio plays through mpv.

entries.name: LRCLIB
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Line-synced lyrics from lrclib.net, as a fallback for Meo Lyrics. Example declarative fnt (lyrics) plugin.

entries.name: ListenBrainz
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Scrobbles what you listen to on ListenBrainz. Example evt (events) plugin.

entries.name: Subsonic / Navidrome
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: Your own music server: Navidrome, Airsonic, Gonic, Ampache, LMS, Jellyfin (Subsonic plugin). Search, home, playlists and albums, radio, lyrics, covers and scrobbling.

entries.name: SomaFM (Go plugin)
entries.author: meofishes
entries.description: SomaFM radios. Example 'process' plugin written in Go: built at install time (needs Go) and free to use any Go library.
